annotation.title_clean: Intelligent Robots Development and Distribution Promotion Act
annotation.title_en: Intelligent Robots Development and Distribution Promotion Act
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Republic of Korea (National Assembly / Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources; Korea Legislation Research Institute translation)
annotation.summary_en: Korea's Intelligent Robots Development and Distribution Promotion Act (latest amendment Oct. 2025) sets five-year basic plans, a robot industry policy council, a robot ethics charter, robotland zones, a research institute, and safety certification and mandatory liability insurance for outdoor mobile (delivery) robots, with penalties.
key_provisions_or_claims: Government adopts five-year basic plans via a policy council under the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources
Government may enact a charter on intelligent robot ethics, supported by a robot ethics advisory committee
Operational safety certification for outdoor mobile robots on sidewalks, with revocation and follow-up management
Operators of certified outdoor mobile robots must buy liability insurance; failure is penalised
Support for robotland zones, the Korea Institute for Robot Industry Advancement, and access for disadvantaged users
